title: Love Strong as Death

questions.question: Oh that you were like a brother to me, who nursed at my mother's what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 8:1 (ESV): "who nursed at my mother's breasts!"

questions.question: Set me as a seal upon your what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 8:6 (ESV): "Set me as a seal upon your heart,"

questions.question: For love is strong as what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 8:6 (ESV): "for love is strong as death,"

questions.question: Jealousy is fierce as the what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 8:6 (ESV): "jealousy is fierce as the grave."

questions.question: Many waters cannot quench what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 8:7 (ESV): "Many waters cannot quench love, neither can floods drown it."

questions.question: I would lead you and bring you into the house of whom?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 8:2 (ESV): "I would lead you and bring you into the house of my mother"

questions.question: I would give you spiced wine to drink, the juice of my what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 8:2 (ESV): "the juice of my pomegranate."

questions.question: Who is that coming up from the wilderness, leaning on her what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 8:5 (ESV): "Who is that coming up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved?"

questions.question: Under the apple tree I awakened whom?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 8:5 (ESV): "Under the apple tree I awakened you."

questions.question: We have a little sister, and she has no what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 8:8 (ESV): "We have a little sister, and she has no breasts."

questions.question: Its flashes are flashes of fire, the very flame of whom?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 8:6 (ESV): "the very flame of the LORD."

questions.question: If she is a wall, we will build on her a battlement of what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 8:9 (ESV): "If she is a wall, we will build on her a battlement of silver,"

questions.question: If she is a door, we will enclose her with boards of what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 8:9 (ESV): "but if she is a door, we will enclose her with boards of cedar."

questions.question: Solomon had a vineyard at where?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 8:11 (ESV): "Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-hamon;"

questions.question: Make haste, my beloved, and be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 8:14 (ESV): "on the mountains of spices."

key_verse_text: Set me as a seal upon your heart, as a seal upon your arm, for love is strong as death, jealousy is fierce as the grave. Its flashes are flashes of fire, the very flame of the LORD.
